quote.text: Non è vero che abbiamo poco tempo, la verità è che ne perdiamo molto.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize that every moment with your children is precious; invest quality time in nurturing their growth rather than getting lost in trivial distractions.
    • Practice mindful presence by balancing discipline with love, ensuring that the time shared builds strong, lasting values and memories.
  • Leadership
    • Embrace the wisdom that time, when used purposefully, becomes a powerful tool for building trust and inspiring those who look to you for guidance.
    • Lead by example—prioritize strategic, deliberate actions over busywork, thereby cultivating a culture where every moment propels the collective mission forward.
  • Product Management
    • Focus on efficiency and clarity in your planning; align every task with the core vision of your product to avoid squandering time on non-essential details.
    • Adopt a deliberate approach to time management—ensure that each decision and iteration brings tangible value, fostering progress and innovation.
